detailed_description:
The target video uses a high-energy, cinematic action style with sharp focus and high contrast lighting.
[Shot 1] A low-angle wide shot establishes <Subject 2>, the industrial café interior with its hanging warm-glow pendant bulbs, exposed dark ceiling beams, and long beige ribbed banquette. <Subject 1>, the woman with dark hair in a low ponytail, silver-framed glasses, a sheer black long-sleeve top, and black flat shoes, runs vertically up the glass storefront window. She plants her hands on the top frame of the window and pulls herself over the edge, transitioning from the floor to the upper wall space.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the camera follows her in a dynamic tracking shot as she runs horizontally along the side wall, passing the illuminated glass shelving. She leaps from the wall, swinging her legs over a row of wooden chairs, and lands on the top surface of the light-wood tables, sliding across them with controlled momentum toward the back of the room.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the shot cuts to a high-angle view looking down from the ceiling. <Subject 1> hangs from the cluster of pendant bulbs, swinging in a wide arc. She releases the bulbs and drops downward, performing a mid-air somersault, and lands gracefully on her feet on the beige banquette, striking a final pose as the camera stabilizes.

overall_soundscape:
Sharp impacts of shoes against glass and wood, the swish of fabric during high-speed movement, and the creaking of wooden furniture under weight.

non_diegetic_music:
A fast-paced, percussive electronic track with driving bass and sharp synth stabs that matches the rhythm of the acrobatic movements.
